parole.significato: somebody who is adduced as a witness to a baptism, godfather, baptismal sponsor
parole.testo: Borrowed from Classical Syriac ܫܰܘܫܒܺܝܢܳܐ (šawšəḇīnā), from Akkadian 𒋢𒊓𒁉𒉡 (/⁠susapinnu⁠/, “paranymph, friend of the bridegroom in a wedding ceremony”), also a foreign word, structure suggesting Anatolian, but strangely attested in Hittite as an Akkadogram.

parole.significato: a woman who is adduced as a witness to a baptism, godfather, baptismal sponsoress
